verdict.rationale: HeyGen's enterprise API page lists "zero data retention options" alongside SOC 2 Type II and audit logs. That is a first-party retention control, but it is a single brief mention and appears to be enterprise-tier only. Missing for 10: documented user-facing deletion controls (e.g., delete endpoints for videos, avatars or uploaded assets), configurable retention periods, availability beyond enterprise plans, detailed docs on how ZDR works, and independent corroboration.
